title: Context-quality gate: verdict per session-peak band with merge-to-session mapping and a Fisher test
body:
Source: t-v9zxepq decision 2026-11-16 (lead + advisor critique). The step-2 gate (t-1nkf30z) cannot be read today: .krn/runs/lead/context-budget/analyze_peak.py reads a frozen gh snapshot (prs2.json, runs.json) from a session scratchpad, maps only 41 of 654 merged PRs to their lead session (PR URLs in transcripts), and its built-in rule (>= 30 per side at >= 150k) is not the gate's. At n=20 vs 30 a first-push-green difference has a standard error of about 11 points, so a 10-point margin is noise.
Outcome: one verdict-printing gate command fetches its own inputs (gh, ledger), maps every lead-shipped merge to its authoring session via the ledger's lead attribution (coverage printed, >= 80% of lead-shipped merges), and per session-peak band (<150k, 150-200k, 200-300k, 300k+) prints n, first-push-green and rework, then one `verdict: pass|fail|inconclusive` for a named band against the <150k band by Fisher's exact test (ADR 0021), inconclusive under 100 merges per band.
Proof: the gate command run on this repository prints coverage >= 80% and a verdict line; a unit test feeds a fixed table and asserts pass, fail and inconclusive.
Files: src/outcome/ledger.ts, .krn/runs/lead/context-budget/analyze_peak.py
